benchmarks: momentum_sign (ret20>0 BUY else SELL; ret20 missing = NO_TRADE)
previous_reaction_sign (last prior reaction >0.5% BUY, < -0.5% SELL, else NO_TRADE)
random_coverage_matched (1000 seeded draws, same number of calls as the continuation rule, random side)
claims: No accuracy claim is made from this run. Results are descriptive pipeline-check statistics on the development period.

costs.note: sensitivity results are reported, never used to choose the primary rule

cutoff.last_usable_session: last trading session whose close + 45 minutes <= cutoff (repository exchange calendar)
cutoff.rule: earliest plausible release E = per-event label nominal (BMO 06:00 ET, AMC 16:00 ET on the event date) or the SEC acceptance time if earlier; cutoff = E minus exactly 24 absolute hours

rules_reported: contrarian (BUY and SELL swapped, same conditions)

entry_exit.entry: market-on-close order for the BASE session close (BMO: previous session, AMC: earnings-day session)
entry_exit.exit: market-on-close order for the REACTION session close
entry_exit.never: price any trade at a close earlier than the cutoff

event_set.exclusions_in_input: cutoffs.csv already excludes unknown timing, no cutoff evidence and entry-before-cutoff events
event_set.label: timing-uncertain (release time never verified); never called verified

features.adv20: mean of close*volume over the last 20 sessions (liquidity)
features.last: last usable session; every window ends at or before it
features.mean4: mean of the symbol's last up to 4 earlier reconstructed reactions whose reaction close + 45 min <= cutoff; needs >= 3
features.rv20: stdev of the last 20 daily returns (diagnostic)

bootstrap.cluster: ISO week of the earnings date

label.name: next-session close-to-close
label.reconstruction: recomputed from the stored regular-session closes (market_time r) with the Phase 2A window rule; must equal the stored move for every dev event or the event is excluded and reported

metrics: strict hit rate (FLAT is a miss)
mean net return per decided call (raw and SPY-adjusted)
by liquidity bucket and timing label
purpose: Offline price-only baseline, DEVELOPMENT-period pipeline check (run once). Not a performance claim; the 100-point Smart Move model is not implemented.

raw_candles.location: local, not in Git; every file hash must match the index

sealing.candle_truncation_date: 2025-10-01 (last reaction close of any dev event); no later price is loaded
sealing.run_once: the run writes a record file and refuses to run again
sealing.unseal: not implemented in this run; any unseal needs a new written approval and a new pre-registration hash

suspect_rule.applies_to: a close-to-close move of the SYMBOL on a session that is not the reaction session of one of its own events
suspect_rule.effect: the affected feature is MISSING (no repair, no imputation); events stay in the dataset
suspect_rule.window: per feature (ret20/rel20/runup5/rv20/adv20: the sessions used; mean4: from each prior event's base close to its reaction close)
